title: Line sketch: Hare Behind the Swirl
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A stylized rabbit with white markings and large ears peeks curiously over a sweeping abstract form. Organic floating shapes in muted earth tones surround the central figure against a plain backdrop. Flat color fields and clean edges define the minimalist composition (derived from painting #122).
